ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached image is a food-web diagram with labeled boxes such as “leopard frog,” “spotted salamander,” “mosquito,” “earthworm,” and others. The box labeled “leopard frog” is on the left side of the diagram. There is an arrow leaving the “leopard frog” box and pointing toward the “spotted salamander” box. Reasoning: In this food web, the arrow from leopard frog to spotted salamander indicates that the spotted salamander feeds on leopard frogs. Therefore, the organism that feeds on leopard frogs is the spotted salamander.
